callees.name: _merge_descriptions
callees.pre_condition: target_desc is a string (an existing description); source_desc is a non-empty string (description text to append)
callees.post_condition: Returns a string formed by appending source_desc to target_desc. If both are non-empty, a single space separates them. If target_desc already contains the full text of source_desc, source_desc is not appended and target_desc is returned unchanged.
